title: XOR After Range Multiplication Queries I
summary: Given an integer array nums of length n and a 2D integer array queries of size q, where each query is represented as [li, ri, ki, vi], for each query, perform the following operations in order: 1.
statement: Given an integer array nums of length n and a 2D integer array queries of size q, where each query is represented as [li, ri, ki, vi], for each query, perform the following operations in order: 1. Set idx to li. 2. While idx is less than or equal to ri: - Update nums[idx] to (nums[idx] * vi) % (10^9 + 7). - Increment idx by ki. 3. After processing all queries, return the bitwise XOR of all elements in nums.
constraints: Each query multiplies indices left,left+step,...<=right modulo 1,000,000,007.
Apply queries in order and return the XOR of the final array.
reference_solution:
def xor_after_range_products(nums,queries):
    mod=10**9+7;nums=nums[:]
    for left,right,step,factor in queries:
        for index in range(left,right+1,step):nums[index]=nums[index]*factor%mod
    answer=0
    for value in nums:answer^=value
    return answer
